G3_faithfulness.justification: The rewritten amplitude conditions are exactly equivalent to requiring every conflicting pair to receive different shifts, with the same bounds, outputs, and lexicographic requirement.

G4_naturalness.justification: The emitter and interference-corridor framing is coherent and readable, though more elaborate than necessary for the underlying graph-coloring task.
